briefing:
# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** Results dated 2–15 November 2026. Nothing was found for the earlier part of the 30-day window.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Regulatory / launch**
- Razorpay received its final Payment Service Provider licence from the IFSCA, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence lets it move money in and out of India from GIFT City under one regulatory framework (https://yourstory.com/2026/11/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-november-02-2026; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-gets-final-ifsca-licence-cross-border-payments-gift-city-126110200734_1.html).
- The licence adds to Razorpay's existing RBI permissions for online, offline and cross-border payments (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/razorpay-gets-gift-city-licence-for-cross-border-payments/articleshow/135470766.cms).

**IPO**
- SEBI issued final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November 2026, clearing the way for the next listing stages (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Reports put the issue at ₹5,000–6,000 crore with a $5 billion valuation target (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ipo-razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-5-000-6-000-crore-issue-eyes-5-billion-valuation/article-202997). Inc42 reports ₹6,000 crore (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo).
- ET says the company is reportedly exploring ₹5,500–6,500 crore and targets a potential 2027 listing (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).

**Deals**
- A 15 November item reports an agreed $9.4 billion acquisition by Globex Corporation, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **Caution:** the snippet does not name the target company, so it cannot be attributed to Razorpay from this source. Verify before the meeting.

**Hires**
- No hires were found in the search results.

## Company background (undated profile)

- HQ in Bangalore; privately held; B2B model (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).
- 12 funding rounds, $834.43M total raised. Listed investors include TeleSoft Partners, Salesforce Ventures and Ribbit Capital (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).

## Flags

- IPO size is reported differently across outlets (₹5,000–6,000 crore vs. ₹5,500–6,500 crore vs. ₹6,000 crore). Confirm the current figure.
- The Globex deal may not involve Razorpay.

## Open questions

1. With the GIFT City PSP licence now final, what is the timeline for launching cross-border money movement, and which corridors come first?
2. Given SEBI's clearance, what is the planned IPO size and timing, and is a 2027 listing still the target?
3. Can you confirm whether Razorpay is party to the Globex transaction reported on 15 November, and how any such deal would affect current partnerships?
